repository_sensitivity.interpretation: Equal repository weighting is a diagnostic sensitivity; too few independent repositories cannot support a population-of-repositories claim.

human_panel.interpretation: Empirical bound against these fixed historical panels, not a universal model capability ceiling.

cost_upper_bound.basis: Conservative usage-based upper bound: input at 2.5 times standard uncached price, output at standard price. Not a verified invoice.

interpretation.original_primary: Frozen human-vote agreement; incomplete valid grids retain descriptive complete-item estimates without a full-cohort interval. Archived execution is a separate diagnostic endpoint.
interpretation.secondary: Added after development and frozen before holdout. Attempted invalid, abstained and error outcomes score zero. Complete grids use all scheduled judgments; with unattempted cells, points condition on fully attempted items and full-cohort intervals are withheld. Original primary remains unchanged.
interpretation.multiplicity: Three paired contrasts receive alpha .05/3 within each declared family. Individual-configuration intervals and diagnostics are exploratory. Primary and secondary families do not have joint error control.
interpretation.archived_execution: Agreement with archived published test outcomes on selected discordant patches; no new agent repair success claim.
interpretation.order: Swap inconsistency is compared with same-order repeat disagreement; neither alone establishes causal position bias.

publisher_revision.change: Captions and footer spacing clarify interpretation; generated SVG line-end whitespace is normalized. Numerical analysis, cohort membership and visual content are unchanged.
